name: Kagome
source: Kagome is a prankster demon and one of the many daughters of [url=/c163009]Ba'el[/url]. She is a general of his army and despite her appearance is unfathomably strong. She doesn't tend to take things too seriously and always wants to have fun by playing pranks. Her most notable prank on Terran was her role in the 1912 sinking of the Titanic.
